summary: Verified /legal page scroll fix. Tested EN & FR across Desktop 1920x800, Short Desktop 1280x600, Mobile 390x740. In every case .legal-page is scrollable (scrollHeight > clientHeight), no horizontal overflow, and the final contact email (llmcouncilsupport@africaisoft.africa, data-testid=legal-contact-email) is reachable and visible in viewport after scrolling to bottom. Back button (legal-back-btn) and language switcher (language-switcher, lang-en/lang-fr) are visible and functional. Regression check: main app #root remains height:100vh overflow:hidden — fix scoped only to .legal-page as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: /legal scroll fix validated. Measurements: Desktop 1920x800 scrollHeight=2432 clientHeight=800; Short Desktop 1280x600 scrollHeight=2432; Mobile 390x740 scrollHeight=4571. Horizontal overflow: none in all cases. Email visible in viewport after scroll-to-bottom in EN and FR.
rca of the issue: Original bug: #root has height:100vh + overflow:hidden (needed by chat app); .legal-page used min-height:100vh so its overflow was clipped by parent with no scrollbar. Fix in Legal.css: .legal-page now uses height:100vh + overflow-y:auto + overflow-x:hidden + -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch to create an internal scroll container. Verified working.
